text_block_list.text: —In the morning, on my way to the academy, I spotted King Halo.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……One more time. Let's check the camera
just one more time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Aah! I can't bear to look...! To think my face... my skin has blemishes...!?

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...? I think it's as cute
as always, though...?

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, why don't you just make it
all sparkly with a filter app~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Natural beauty without relying on apps!
Staying radiant is what makes one a King!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, we're overhauling everything, including your diet!
And that goes for all of you, too!
It seems King Halo is troubled by skin problems...
